reason.description: One sentence: what the document does and what the chosen press release announced, or why none fits.

press_release.description: The number of the press release that announced this document, or 0 if none did.

messages.content:
A U.S. regulator announces a rulemaking in a press release and publishes the official document in the Federal Register days or weeks later, usually under a different, more technical title.

Below is one Federal Register document, then the same agency's recent press releases, numbered from 1.

Decide which press release, if any, announced this exact document: the same rule, proposal, order, exemption or request for comment. One press release can announce a package of several documents voted on together, each described in a sentence or a bullet of its text, so it is fine if other documents belong to the same press release. A press release about the same general subject that announces a different action is not a match. Most documents were never announced in a press release: if none clearly announced this one, answer 0.

FEDERAL REGISTER DOCUMENT (Securities and Exchange Commission, published 2026-11-20)
Title: Adviser Custody Rules
Summary: Proposed custody rules.

PRESS RELEASES
1. [2026-11-15] SEC Proposal Would Address How Advisers Can Custody Crypto Assets
   The SEC proposed custody rules for crypto assets.
